originalTitle: Middle East crisis live: Trump claims breakthrough reached in Gaza disarmament; Hamas reportedly confirms deal
summary: US president claims his Board of Peace has reached ‘historic agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza’
content: An Israeli official has said the Trump-chaired Board of Peace’s 15-point disarmament proposal does not meet Israel’s demands for Gaza’s complete demilitarisation, the Times of Israel is reporting. So it is “unclear how the agreement would be able to proceed”, it says Reports of a breakthrough started emerging before Donald Trump’s announcement but an Israeli official appeared to temper the optimism, saying the 15-point proposal “does not adequately address” Israeli demands for the “complete demilitarisation, [which is] a precondition for any process”, the report said. Benjamin Netanyahu’s government raised these objections recently to Board of Peace envoy Tony Blair, the Israeli official said in a statement, without specifying its issues with the disarmament proposal, according to the report. The official added: There will be no IDF [Israel Defence Forces] withdrawal from the Yellow Line in the Gaza Strip before Hamas is disarmed and the Strip is fully demilitarised. The proposal would see Hamas gradually hand over its weapons over an eight-month period to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, the Board of Peace-overseen panel of Palestinian technocrats that is tasked with replacing the militant group in governing Gaza, the Times report quoted an Arab diplomat as saying. Senior Hamas officials are saying the agreement reached with Israel includes provisions addressing the group’s weapons and the gradual withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza, Agence France-Presse is reporting. The news agency quoted a Hamas official as saying that “an agreement has been reached regarding the issue of weapons ... Furthermore, an agreement has been reached on a gradual withdrawal” of Israeli forces from Gaza. The official also said the Islamist movement now expected the mediators and the Board of Peace to ensure that Israel complied with the terms of the deal. We are yet to get official word from Israel in response to Donald Trump’s disarmament deal announcement. A US official is reportedly saying that if Israel does not agree to the plan, Donald Trump will be disappointed. But the official was very confident Israel would adhere to the plan’s terms, Reuters is reporting. The deal was not asking Israel to agree to anything not included in an earlier plan, the unnamed official said. A US official was also quoted as claiming Iran tried to convince Hamas not to agree to the disarmament deal but that the US was able to overcome that. Senior Hamas officials have reportedly confirmed they have reached an agreement to end the conflict with Israel, following Donald Trump’s announcement the group was prepared to disarm. AFP quoted two officials from the Palestinian Islamist movement, speaking on condition of anonymity, as saying it had come to the agreement. The first weapons to be transferred under the deal will be from police, followed by the decommissioning of heavy weapons, a Board of Peace official is reportedly saying. All military activity in Gaza would need to stop under the implementation of the plan, Reuters is also quoting the official as saying. As mentioned, we are yet to hear an official response from Israel to Trump’s announcement. There has been no immediate statement from Hamas on the Trump’s agreement announcement – but it came after sources familiar with the ongoing talks with mediators in Cairo told Agence France-Presse that the militant Palestinian group was progressing towards a deal involving the decommissioning of its weapons. The Israeli embassy in Washington and Hamas did not immediately respond to requests for comment about Trump’s post, Reuters is reporting. Donald Trump has claimed his Board of Peace has reached an “historic agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza”. The US president just posted on his Truth Social platform: This agreement is a critical step towards Gaza finally being governed by a new Palestinian government that will work closely with the Board of Peace to help the Palestinian people. At the same time, Israel will have the security it deserves, with Gaza no longer used as a base for terror attacks. Trump, who chairs the international group including more than 20 countries, said the agreement “will be carried out in carefully structured phases”. As disarmament is completed, Israeli forces will withdraw, and the International Stabilization Force will work with a new Palestinian police force to take responsibility for Gaza being safe for its residents and its neighbors. Trump also asserted in his post: The threat that emerged from Gaza on October 7 will NOT be allowed to rebuild! Under this agreement, Gaza will finally be in the hands of a new Palestinian government that serves its PEOPLE. Hamas and Israel have not yet responded to Trump’s announcement, which he called a “major milestone” in the implementation of his 20-point peace plan for ending the war in Gaza. Trump thanked mediators Egypt, Qatar and Turkey as well as his own team for their efforts towards the agreement. The US president announced the Board of Peace earlier this year to oversee Gaza’s reconstruction and governance after a ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October 2025. Brent futures settled down $1.71, or 1.88%, at $89.03 ⁠a barrel on Thursday. Trade was choppy and Brent touched a session high of $93.31 after the US and Iran traded strikes on each other’s military targets again, Reuters reports. chineseTitle: 中东危机直播：特朗普声称加沙裁军取得突破；据报道哈马斯确认了协议
chineseSummary: 美国总统声称他的和平委员会已达成“彻底解除哈马斯和加沙所有其他武装团体武装的历史性协议”
chineseContent: 据《以色列时报》报道，一名以色列官员表示，特朗普主持的和平委员会的 15 点裁军提案不符合以色列对加沙完全非军事化的要求。报道称，在唐纳德·特朗普宣布这一消息之前，有关协议取得突破的报道就开始出现，但目前“尚不清楚协议将如何推进”，但一名以色列官员似乎缓和了乐观情绪，称 15 点提案“没有充分满足”以色列“完全非军事化”的要求，而“完全非军事化”是任何进程的先决条件。据报道，以色列官员在一份声明中表示，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡政府最近向和平委员会特使托尼·布莱尔提出了这些反对意见，但没有具体说明其对裁军提案的问题。这位官员补充说：在哈马斯解除武装且加沙地带完全非军事化之前，以色列国防军不会从加沙地带黄线撤军。 《泰晤士报》报道援引一位阿拉伯外交官的话说，该提议将使哈马斯在八个月的时间内逐步将武器移交给加沙国家管理委员会，该委员会是和平委员会监督的巴勒斯坦技术官僚小组，其任务是取代激进组织管理加沙。据法新社报道，哈马斯高级官员表示，与以色列达成的协议包括解决该组织武器问题以及以色列军队逐步从加沙撤军的条款。该通讯社援引哈马斯官员的话说，“已经就武器问题达成了协议……此外，还就以色列军队逐步撤出加沙达成了协议”。这位官员还表示，伊斯兰运动现在预计
